calendarNotes: Dallas ISD’s 2026–27 traditional calendar starts August 11, 2026 and ends May 26, 2027. The calendar lists 175 student days, a two-day fall break on October 8–9, teacher professional development days on October 12, November 3, and January 5, winter break from December 21 through January 4, spring break from March 15–19, early-release days in December and May, and inclement weather days on March 29 and April 19.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every Dallas ISD school follow this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page summarizes the traditional districtwide calendar. Dallas ISD also publishes an ADSY calendar, and individual campuses may publish separate events, bell schedules, and program deadlines.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import, so later Dallas ISD calendar changes will not appear automatically.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should I check for calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official Dallas ISD district calendars page before making travel, child care, or campus-specific plans.

comparisonSummary: Dallas ISD and Plano ISD start August 11. Garland ISD and Fort Worth ISD start August 10, while Frisco ISD starts August 12. All five districts schedule spring break for March 15–19.

customSections.label: What Changed from 2025–26
customSections.content: The 2026–27 traditional calendar has 175 student days. The table below highlights the main date changes from 2025–26.

rows: First day moves from August 12, 2025, to August 11, 2026
The school year starts one calendar day earlier than the prior traditional calendar.
Final student day moves from May 27, 2026, to May 26, 2027
The school year also ends one calendar day earlier.
Fall break moves from October 9–10 to October 8–9
October 12 is also a student no-school day for teacher professional development, so classes resume October 13.
Spring break moves from March 16–20 to March 15–19
The break begins and ends one day earlier than in 2025–26.

events.description: March 29 and April 19 are reserved weather days. Either date may become an instructional day if Dallas ISD needs to make up a closure.
